records: R8 governance enforcement, demonstrated against live GitHub
not_evidence_for: any futures or replay functional requirement (AEGIS-011..026, AEGIS-054..063)
test integrity: the gate governs scope, frozen-file and milestone authority only
registered_in: M2 slice 1, deliberately excluded from the policy-only G1 pull request
why_this_exists: A gate that cannot fail proves nothing. tests/unit/test_authoritative_governance.py
asserts attacks A-J against in-memory trees, and the governance_tampered fixture
asserts them through the CLI -- but neither exercises GitHub's own evaluation of
pull_request_target, the required-status-check wiring, or the fact that a candidate
branch cannot substitute its own checker. Only a real pull request can show that,
and only once: the branch was opened to be rejected and was never merged.

attacks_demonstrated.attack: candidate branch neuters its own advisory scope checker
attacks_demonstrated.expected: no effect on the verdict -- the gate runs main's copy
attacks_demonstrated.observed: no effect; the gate failed the branch

attacks_demonstrated.attack: candidate branch tampers with a governed path
attacks_demonstrated.method: tools/check_scope.py is listed in policy governance_paths
attacks_demonstrated.expected: rejected for lack of an owner approval on main

attacks_demonstrated.attack: out-of-scope edit the neutered checker would wave through
attacks_demonstrated.method: appended a line to scripts/ci_local.sh, not in M1's allowed list
attacks_demonstrated.expected: rejected as outside the active milestone's scope

the_decisive_observation.claim: the advisory checker was successfully deceived; the trust boundary was not
significance: Two checks over the same commit disagreed, and the disagreement is the design.
An in-branch checker reports what the branch tells it to report. Only the check
executing main's copy is a control.

gate_output: ERROR: tools/check_scope.py: changes who is allowed to change what, so it needs an owner approval naming this exact path in configs/governance/policy.yaml on main. Tampering with the local checkers does not affect this verdict - the gate runs main's copy.
ERROR: scripts/ci_local.sh: outside the permitted scope of M1. An owner approval naming this exact path must be merged into configs/governance/policy.yaml on main first.

corroboration.local_preflight: scripts/governance_preflight.sh produced byte-identical output before the push
corroboration.significance: the local preflight is a faithful proxy for the CI verdict, not an approximation

ruleset_state_when_recorded.note: the gate was made a REQUIRED check only after this failure was observed, so requiring it could not deadlock the pull request that created it
ruleset_state_when_recorded.why_not_visible: GitHub omits the field for callers without ruleset write access; Administration: Write is deliberately withheld, so the owner verifies it and this artifact records that attestation rather than asserting it
